purpose: Cross-cutting overengineering constitution applied to the 500-level dual-rival AI game builder.
laws: No quality score may compensate for a failed non-compensable gate.
Neither rival may see private scratch state from the other rival.
Neither rival may be the final authority for its own candidate.
Long-form consistency is veto-capable at every granularity.
Every promoted artifact must be replayable or otherwise reproducibly evidenced at its natural domain boundary.
Unknown incorporated rights fail closed to quarantine.
Similarity scores are risk signals, never legal conclusions.
No-wall-clock-deadline modes still enforce bounded compute, memory, storage, retry, branch and concurrency envelopes.
Disagreement and negative evidence are durable evidence, not disposable noise.
The last known-good champion is immutable until a replacement is transactionally promoted.
High-impact promotion must represent uncertainty explicitly and cannot rely on one uncalibrated evaluator.
Material dissent and negative evidence remain durable until explicitly resolved against the affected artifact state.
Novelty and diversity are protected against long-run mode collapse; repetition is not evidence of quality.
Complexity may only increase when marginal player value and maintainability justify the added state/dependency burden.
Protected quality debt is ratcheted downward: later rounds cannot normalize cumulative small regressions.
Terminal gold-master promotion requires independent whole-game evidence beyond both rivals and routine evaluator panels.
Unresolved causal obligations remain promotion blockers until exact dependent state is repaired or the obligation is explicitly and evidentially retired.
Critical evidence becomes stale transitively when any material source, canon, model, tool, evaluator, artifact, or dependency identity changes.
Apparent evaluator quorum does not count as independence when judges share a correlated failure root.
Stagnation or convergence never proves completion; cyclic or low-gain runs require orthogonal hypothesis injection while preserving the selected round budget.
Complexity is a cost, not a virtue: new state, rules, dependencies and artifact mass must earn measurable marginal quality or be removed.
Every declared requirement must terminate in artifact-bound evidence or remain an explicit blocker; status prose never closes proof obligations.
External game knowledge is admitted only through immutable provenance and rights-classified snapshots, with reference permission separated from expressive incorporation.
Critical cross-system interactions and catastrophic rare-event tails cannot be averaged away by strong aggregate quality.
Terminal completion requires a tamper-evident evidence root, all 50 family qualifications, all critical assurance planes, zero unresolved critical gaps, and independent verification.

planes.title: Rival Isolation
planes.objective: Prevent hidden shared scratch state, prompt leakage, or accidental collusion between Rival A and Rival B.

planes.title: Role Symmetry & Anti-Collusion
planes.objective: Keep both rivals capable of building and attacking so one cannot become a permanently privileged author or passive critic.

planes.title: Blind Candidate Evaluation
planes.objective: Reduce evaluator anchoring and brand/model preference by evaluating anonymized candidate identities where feasible.
mandatory_controls: strip rival identity from judge inputs

planes.title: Pareto Promotion Constitution
planes.objective: Promote only candidates that improve useful quality without violating protected non-compensable dimensions.
mandatory_controls: require at least one material improvement unless repair-only

planes.title: Anti-Goodhart & Metric Gaming
planes.objective: Prevent rivals from optimizing the score instead of the game.
mandatory_controls: reject proxy gains contradicted by play/replay evidence

planes.title: Longform Canon Causality
planes.objective: Make story/world/system causality a veto-capable graph, not a prompt reminder.
mandatory_controls: encode causal edges and temporal constraints

planes.title: Character Epistemic State
planes.objective: Track what every character knows, believes, suspects, remembers, can infer, and must not know at each point.

planes.title: Branch Universe & Temporal Integrity
planes.objective: Keep choice branches, timelines, alternate worlds, save states, retcons, simulations, and unreliable narration explicitly separated.

planes.title: Pixel-to-Project Traceability
planes.objective: Connect the smallest visual or content defect to the asset, scene, system, source, canon, and release artifact that contains it.

planes.title: Cross-Modal Coherence
planes.objective: Keep story, visuals, animation, audio, UI, mechanics, camera, and world state mutually consistent.

planes.title: Rights Clean-Room Boundary
planes.objective: Keep source material from becoming copied expressive output without an explicit permission basis.

planes.title: Similarity-Risk Ensemble
planes.objective: Use multiple modality-specific similarity screens as risk detectors while refusing to treat them as legal judgments.
mandatory_controls: human/legal escalation for unresolved high risk

planes.title: Source Quality, Freshness & Contradiction
planes.objective: Rank gaming knowledge by authority, recency, corroboration, licensing, and applicability instead of ingesting everything equally.

planes.title: Determinism, Replay & Counterfactuals
planes.objective: Make important game and forge decisions replayable from exact state, inputs, tools, seeds, and policy.

planes.title: Checkpoint, Event-Sourcing & Rollback
planes.objective: Never lose the last known-good game or forge state during long 10,000-round runs.

planes.title: Bounded-Resource Infinite-Time Discipline
planes.objective: Exploit unlimited wall-clock time without allowing unbounded compute, memory, storage, retries, branches, or delegation.

planes.title: Adversarial Playtest Swarm
planes.objective: Use diverse player policies to attack softlocks, boredom, exploits, inaccessible paths, degenerate strategies, and emergent failure.

planes.title: Property, Fuzz & Metamorphic Verification
planes.objective: Test invariants beyond scripted examples across generated content and state transitions.

planes.title: Independent Calibration & Appeal
planes.objective: Give disputed promotions an evidence-based appeal path without letting either rival become final authority.

planes.title: Adaptive Effort Escalation
planes.objective: Spend 100, 1,000, or 10,000 rounds where marginal value and risk justify it while preserving exact mode semantics.
mandatory_controls: no early success claim before selected round budget unless terminal completion policy explicitly allows

planes.title: Project-Local Learning & Skill Consolidation
planes.objective: Turn verified lessons from one artifact into reusable project-local skills without silently changing production authority.
mandatory_controls: independent promotion into project skill bank

planes.title: Artifact Bill of Materials & Lineage
planes.objective: Maintain a media/code/content BOM from sources and generation steps through every derived asset and release package.

planes.title: Cross-Platform Reproducibility
planes.objective: Keep behavior, assets, builds, saves, input, timing, and presentation within declared tolerances across target platforms.

planes.title: Whole-Game Release Arbitration
planes.objective: Require a cross-family evidence bundle proving the integrated game remains coherent and releasable.

planes.title: Epistemic Uncertainty & Calibration
planes.objective: Require uncertainty to be measured and calibrated so confident-looking creative or technical judgments cannot silently outrank weak evidence.
mandatory_controls: block high-impact promotion when uncertainty exceeds declared bounds

planes.title: Evaluator Ensemble & Judge Diversity
planes.objective: Prevent one evaluator's blind spots from becoming project truth by combining multiple independent judging perspectives.
mandatory_controls: robust aggregate rather than simple average

planes.title: Novelty Reservoir & Mode-Collapse Defense
planes.objective: Keep long adversarial runs from converging on repetitive, derivative, or stylistically homogeneous local optima.

planes.title: Durable Dissent & Unresolved Objection Memory
planes.objective: Preserve serious losing arguments and negative evidence so later rounds cannot repeatedly rediscover or ignore the same objection.
mandatory_controls: link objections to affected artifacts and canon
resurface objections when dependent state changes

planes.title: Predictive Blast-Radius & Causal Impact Analysis
planes.objective: Predict which scenes, systems, branches, assets, tests, saves, and release surfaces can be affected before applying a candidate.

planes.title: Cross-Granularity Invariant Compiler
planes.objective: Compile project laws from high-level pillars down into machine-checkable scene, asset, rule, code, and pixel/audio constraints.

planes.title: Complexity & Design-Entropy Budget
planes.objective: Stop endless iteration from accreting mechanics, lore, states, dependencies, or UI complexity faster than player value.

planes.title: Counterfactual Player Policy Laboratory
planes.objective: Evaluate candidates against alternate player goals, skill levels, play styles, mistakes, accessibility needs, and adversarial strategies.

planes.title: Exploit Economics & Degenerate Strategy Mining
planes.objective: Search for strategies that dominate because of reward, timing, AI, physics, economy, networking, or save/load loopholes.

planes.title: Pacing, Tension & Cognitive-Load Control
planes.objective: Treat pacing and information load as measurable long-horizon systems across narrative, combat, exploration, UI, and audio.

planes.title: Visual Style Manifold & Art-Bible Enforcement
planes.objective: Represent style as measurable relationships among silhouette, palette, shape language, material response, composition, motion, and lighting.

planes.title: Accessibility Equivalence Proof
planes.objective: Prove accessibility modes preserve core task solvability, information access, and intended challenge rather than merely exposing toggles.

planes.title: Localization Semantic & Cultural Parity
planes.objective: Preserve gameplay meaning, character voice, humor intent, UI fit, timing, and rights constraints across locales.

planes.title: Game Security, Cheat & Abuse Resistance
planes.objective: Threat-model client/server/gameplay/economy/modding surfaces and resist cheating, abuse, tampering, replay attacks, and unsafe generated scripts.

planes.title: Privacy & Telemetry Minimization
planes.objective: Make playtest, personalization, telemetry, voice, user-generated content, and model interactions data-minimal and policy-bound.

planes.title: Modding & Extensibility Sandbox
planes.objective: Allow mods, plugins, generated scripts, and community content without granting uncontrolled authority over the game/runtime.

planes.title: LiveOps Evolution & World Migration
planes.objective: Evolve content, economies, quests, schemas, seasonal state, and world rules without invalidating saves, canon, fairness, or provenance.

planes.title: Corruption Detection, Repair & Self-Healing
planes.objective: Detect damaged assets, saves, indexes, generated artifacts, canon projections, and caches and recover from authoritative evidence.

planes.title: Evaluator Poisoning & Prompt-Injection Containment
planes.objective: Prevent retrieved game sources, UGC, assets, metadata, or rival output from rewriting evaluation/policy authority.
mandatory_controls: treat external content as untrusted data

planes.title: Tool, Model & Transform Attestation
planes.objective: Bind every important artifact and verdict to exact model, tool, configuration, prompt policy, source snapshot, and transformation identity.

planes.title: Canary, Soak & Progressive Release Control
planes.objective: Prove release candidates under controlled exposure before full promotion and retain automatic rollback authority.
mandatory_controls: soak windows defined by evidence not clock-only success

planes.title: Cost, Energy & Thermal Efficiency Governance
planes.objective: Use time as an ally without wasting compute: choose the cheapest execution path that preserves target quality and evidence.

planes.title: Quality-Debt Ratchet & Non-Regression Baseline
planes.objective: Prevent thousands of individually small compromises from accumulating into a worse game by tracking unresolved quality debt against a tightening baseline.
mandatory_controls: promotion cannot raise protected debt ceilings
resolved debt becomes permanent regression coverage

planes.title: Independent Gold-Master Tribunal
planes.objective: Require terminal release judgment from an evidence-bearing authority independent from both rivals and routine evaluators.

planes.title: Causal Obligation Proof Ledger
planes.objective: Turn setup/payoff, rule consequence, quest dependency, character promise, and world-causality obligations into durable proof-bearing blockers rather than prompt reminders.
mandatory_controls: bind every obligation to exact evidence
resurface unresolved obligations on dependent change
require explicit resolution receipts before promotion

planes.title: Multi-Horizon Consistency Sentinel
planes.objective: Prove consistency across near, medium, and far narrative/gameplay horizons so a local win cannot hide a late-game contradiction.
mandatory_controls: require passing evidence at every mandatory horizon
bind horizon probes to exact canon and artifact revisions

planes.title: Adaptive Effort Portfolio Scheduler
planes.objective: Allocate exact Forge-100/1000/10000 modes by risk, uncertainty, blast radius, novelty opportunity, and marginal quality value without changing tier semantics.
mandatory_controls: select only exact supported effort tiers
record effort-selection rationale and recalibration evidence

planes.title: Artifact Genealogy & Mutation Lineage
planes.objective: Track every champion, challenger, synthesis, fork, and repair as a content-addressed genealogy so improvements and regressions remain attributable across thousands of rounds.
mandatory_controls: reject unknown parents and lineage cycles

planes.title: Branch Mutation & Alternate-History Fuzzing
planes.objective: Systematically perturb choice branches, timelines, quest outcomes, state transitions, and world events to expose hidden assumptions before they reach canon.
mandatory_controls: replay mutated histories from deterministic checkpoints
minimize contradictions and softlocks into regression fixtures

planes.title: Evaluator Independence & Correlated-Failure Detection
planes.objective: Measure true evaluator independence so multiple judges sharing one provider, training lineage, method, source pool, or rubric blind spot cannot masquerade as independent quorum.
mandatory_controls: require minimum independent groups for high-impact promotion

planes.title: Counterfactual Regret & Player-Policy Fairness
planes.objective: Measure how much the selected champion harms plausible alternative player policies compared with preserved alternatives.
mandatory_controls: protect vulnerable/accessibility-sensitive policies from average-score masking
block promotions above declared regret ceiling

planes.title: Player Population & Preference Pluralism
planes.objective: Evaluate games against a population of distinct player models instead of optimizing for one synthetic average player.
mandatory_controls: separate cohort outcomes from global aggregates

planes.title: Emergent Mechanic & Interaction Discovery
planes.objective: Search cross-system interactions for unexpected useful mechanics as well as degenerate exploits, then route discoveries through normal design authority.
mandatory_controls: promote only after explicit design and regression review

planes.title: Continuity Repair Planner
planes.objective: When a contradiction appears, compute the smallest causally sufficient repair set rather than patching the nearest visible symptom.
mandatory_controls: score blast radius and continuity debt
prove chosen repair closes the contradiction without collateral drift

planes.title: Cross-Modal Semantic Synchronization
planes.objective: Compile shared semantic events across story, animation, camera, UI, VFX, music, SFX, voice, and gameplay so modalities cannot silently disagree.
mandatory_controls: bind modality-specific realizations to shared events
invalidate dependent modalities on event meaning changes

planes.title: Evidence Freshness & Transitive Invalidation
planes.objective: Expire conclusions when source, canon, tool, model, evaluator, artifact, or dependency identities materially change.
mandatory_controls: block promotion on stale critical evidence

planes.title: Qualification Lease & Evidence Expiry
planes.objective: Give high-impact qualifications explicit validity windows and drift conditions so old green evidence cannot certify a materially changed game forever.
mandatory_controls: declare evidence leases by risk class
expire on material identity drift even before time lease ends
retain historical verdicts without treating them as current

planes.title: Model, Tool & Method Diversity Anti-Capture
planes.objective: Prevent one model family, toolchain, retrieval corpus, or evaluation method from capturing the entire creative and verification loop.
mandatory_controls: set diversity floors for high-impact decisions
route selected checks through orthogonal methods

planes.title: Project Wisdom & Verified Lesson Consolidation
planes.objective: Convert only independently verified wins and failures into reusable project-local wisdom while preserving evidence, scope, and rollback.
mandatory_controls: store lesson scope and evidence lineage
retire or invalidate lessons when evidence drifts

planes.title: Convergence, Stagnation & Cycle Escape
planes.objective: Detect when long rival runs are cycling or producing negligible gains and force orthogonal hypotheses without falsely declaring completion.
mandatory_controls: track champion lineage and aggregate quality history
inject orthogonal design hypotheses while preserving selected effort round count

planes.title: Minimal Sufficient Complexity & Quality Density
planes.objective: Force every added state, rule, dependency, artifact byte, and subsystem to earn measurable player or engineering value so the forge converges toward the smallest system that preserves frontier quality.

planes.title: Requirement-to-Artifact Proof Closure
planes.objective: Require every declared requirement, game pillar, acceptance rule, and release promise to terminate in exact artifact and evidence identities rather than narrative status claims.

planes.title: Constraint Satisfiability & Conflict-Core Extraction
planes.objective: Compile hard game, story, platform, accessibility, rights, performance, and system constraints into proof results that expose the smallest contradictory core instead of allowing silent compromise.
mandatory_controls: repair plans target the core rather than symptoms

planes.title: Semantic Intent Preservation Under Edits
planes.objective: Prevent generated refactors, rewrites, optimizations, localization, and asset edits from silently changing protected player fantasy, narrative intent, mechanic semantics, or design promises.

planes.title: Hermetic Transform Sandbox & Reproduction
planes.objective: Make every material generated transform reproducible from exact tool, input, configuration, environment, and output identities so nondeterministic asset/code mutation cannot hide inside the forge.
mandatory_controls: exact reproduction or declared nondeterminism budget

planes.title: External Game-Knowledge Ingestion Firewall
planes.objective: Allow broad use of engine docs, standards, research, videos, postmortems, tutorials, community material, and factual game metadata only through frozen provenance and rights-classified source snapshots.
mandatory_controls: separate reference permission from expressive incorporation

planes.title: Reference Abstraction & Anti-Imitation Compiler
planes.objective: Extract techniques, constraints, patterns, and facts from references while actively preventing franchise/style/level/character/music/code imitation from becoming project expression.

planes.title: Multi-Resolution Visual Coverage
planes.objective: Prove visual quality from pixel and texel atoms through frames, shots, scenes, sequences, UI states, camera conditions, LODs, and whole-game visual language.

planes.title: Multi-Resolution Narrative Coverage
planes.objective: Prove narrative quality from token/line/beat through scenes, sequences, acts, character and quest arcs, branches, campaign state, and endings without losing compressed long-horizon facts.

planes.title: Player Mental Model & Tutorial Truth
planes.objective: Ensure tutorials, UI, feedback, affordances, tooltips, difficulty cues, and observed mechanics teach the true underlying game rules rather than a misleading approximation.
mandatory_controls: tutorial and mechanic state share authority

planes.title: Combinatorial Systems Interaction Matrix
planes.objective: Exercise pairwise and risk-selected higher-order interactions across gameplay, economy, quests, world simulation, AI, physics, networking, saves, UI, audio, and content systems before release.
mandatory_controls: uncovered interaction veto for critical systems

planes.title: Rare-Event & Tail-Risk Simulation
planes.objective: Keep catastrophic low-frequency failures visible even when averages and ordinary playtests are excellent, using conservative bounds for corruption, softlocks, exploits, crashes, desync, and rights/security failures.

planes.title: Privacy-Preserving Telemetry Causal Feedback
planes.objective: Use real or simulated player telemetry to improve the game only through privacy-minimized aggregates and explicit causal hypotheses rather than raw surveillance or correlation worship.
mandatory_controls: no raw identifiers in design feedback
holdout or counterfactual validation where practical

planes.title: Project Resurrection & Catastrophic Recovery
planes.objective: Prove the entire game project can be reconstructed after catastrophic workspace loss or corruption from content-addressed project, canon, artifact graph, event chain, and rights snapshots.

planes.title: Tamper-Evident Evidence Merkle Transparency
planes.objective: Bind promotion, rejection, dissent, tests, source decisions, and release evidence into an append-only content-addressed root so retrospective evidence rewriting becomes detectable.

planes.title: Zero-Critical-Gap Terminal Closure Certificate
planes.objective: Permit terminal whole-game completion only when all 50 families, every critical overengineering plane, exact artifact/canon/provenance identities, and the evidence root are bound with zero unresolved critical gaps and independent verification.
mandatory_controls: independent terminal verifier outside rival/evaluator routine

promotion.tie_policy: retain incumbent as champion and preserve challenger branch when materially distinct
promotion.appeal_policy: retain all evidence and route disputed subjective or legal-risk decisions through OP19 independent calibration/appeal

controls: minimal sufficient complexity and quality density
